content:
eric_sales: FYI prospect (NordBank EU) marked vendor-risk as a gating item. They asked for: 1) EU-only data flow diagram, 2) subprocessor roster indicating which ones touch PII, 3) confirmation that backups & logs with PII never leave EU. Need a small deliverable by tomorrow AM.

zoe_presales: I can put together a one-page DFD PNG and a CSV. Quick Q: is Dedicated EU-only acceptable or do they require Private/on-prem?

eric_sales: Dedicated pinned to EU is OK. Hosted only if we can lock region and guarantee no cross-border backups/fallbacks.

dario_security: Key technical notes to include: customer-managed KMS in EU supported; Redwood HSM available for tenants with split-escrow only if contractually agreed. Ephemeral KV cache on Hosted; persistent Redis in EU for Dedicated/Private. Metrics must be pseudonymized before storage and held in EU buckets.

zoe_presales: Draft routing snippet to paste into pack:
```yaml
deployment:
  mode: hosted
  region_policy:
    allowed_regions: [eu-west-1, eu-central-1]
    allow_fallback: false
storage:
  backups:
    cross_region: false
    retention_region: eu-central-1
cache:
  persistent_kv: false
```

maya_legal: Please include a sample DPA subprocessor clause: "Redwood will notify Customer 30 days prior to onboarding any new subprocessor that may process Customer Data; Customer may reasonably object." I'll prepare full DPA language if they need edits.

zoe_presales: Subprocessor CSV preview (name | role | data_classes | region | eu_residency_flag):
- Google Cloud | infra/compute/storage | encrypted blobs (may contain PII) | europe-west3 | yes
- Datadog | monitoring | metrics (pseudonymized) | eu-tenant | yes
- Sentry | error-tracking | traces (PII-scrubbed) | eu-hosts | yes
- Zendesk | support | ticket metadata | eu-tenant | yes
- HashiCorp Vault / customer KMS | key-mgmt | keys | customer/EU | yes

dario_security: Also note: backups containing PII will be disabled in this configuration; audit logs can be exported to EU-only buckets; recommend KMS rotation every 90 days and strict key access logging.

eric_sales: They also asked for a one-paragraph SIG/CAIQ-friendly answer about encryption and segregation. Can someone draft a paste-ready line?

zoe_presales: Paste-ready: "Redwood enforces encryption in transit (TLS1.2+) and at rest (AES-256). Tenant-level segregation is applied across deployment modes. Dedicated and Private use VPC-level segmentation; Hosted provides logical tenant isolation with strict routing policies and optional VPC peering. Customers may supply and manage KMS keys in EU for key sovereignty; access is logged and auditable."

maya_legal: Add sentence: "Redwood maintains SOC2 Type II and ISO 27001 mappings; evidence can be provided under NDA."

redwood-bot: asset uploaded: /internal/security/dfd/1793456789-nordbank-eu-dfd.png (sha256:3f5a1c9b2d4e)

zoe_presales: Uploaded DFD and I'll post the CSV + CAIQ blurb + quick pricing delta (50 RPS) in ~3 hours. Pricing note: Hosted (EU-pin) baseline; Dedicated EU-only ~ +40-50% vs hosted; Private requires SOW.

eric_sales: Perfect. Once bundle is in thread I'll send to NordBank security and loop in legal for any evidence requests. Thanks team :thumbsup:
